description: This file defines the ServiceLogging class, which extends CustomLogger to provide monitoring and logging functionalities for services related to litellm, including integration with Prometheus, Datadog, and OpenTelemetry. It handles both synchronous and asynchronous service success and failure hooks, and manages external logger instances.

classes.description: A specialized logger class for monitoring health of litellm-adjacent services (redis, postgres), extending the CustomLogger for detailed service success and failure tracking.
